goal: Sign on to the MeridianCore servicing console, open Member Servicing, look up the member whose number is given by the member_id input, and read that member's Regular Savings account: its current balance and its status. Also read the member's name from the member record.
summary:
Signed on to MeridianCore, navigated to Member Servicing, looked up member 100244, and retrieved: member name ([REDACTED]:output:member_name), Regular Savings current balance ($4,812.37), and status (OPEN). All outputs extracted successfully. // Probed all four failure/edge scenarios on the live MeridianCore session:

1. Member not found (999999): Console shows 'Member Servicing — Inquiry / No member matching that number was found. / Searched member number: 999999' — registered as declare_outcome 'member_not_found' (return_to_caller).

2. Access restricted (100999, EXECUTIVE SERVICES flag): Console shows 'Access Restricted / You do not have permission to view this member. / Member 100999 is flagged EXECUTIVE SERVICES. A supervisor override is required to continue.' with a 'Supervisor Override' button visible — registered as declare_outcome 'member_access_restricted' (escalate_to_human) since a supervisor can clear it on the same session.

3. Interstitial notice: A one-time 'System Notice' appeared the first time Member Servicing was opened after sign-on: 'Scheduled maintenance window 02:00–03:00 CT. Batch posting may be delayed. This notice is shown once per sign-on.' It is cleared via the 'Acknowledge and Continue' button — registered as declare_recovery 'system_maintenance_notice'.

4. Sandbox fault state: Re-looking up member 100244 produced 'Application Error / SYSTEM ERROR MC-5001 / The host transaction could not be completed. Contact the service desk with this reference.' — registered as declare_failure 'host_transaction_error' since this must stop the run rather than be treated as a business answer.

All outcomes verified against live screen text and registered with exact wording.

actions.intent: Enter the operator ID to sign on
Enter the operator passcode to sign on
Sign on to the servicing console
actions.expect: Main menu or Member Servicing navigation appears

actions.intent: Open Member Servicing to look up the member
actions.expect: Member Servicing screen with a member lookup field appears

actions.intent: Dismiss the system notice to proceed to Member Servicing
Enter the member number to look up
Search for the member's account summary
actions.expect: Member account summary with Regular Savings account details appears

actions.intent: Return to Member Servicing to search for a non-existent member number
Enter a non-existent member number to see the not-found message
Search for the non-existent member to observe the not-found message
actions.expect: An error or not-found message appears instead of member details

actions.intent: Start a new search to look up the entitlement-restricted member
Enter the executive-services flagged member number to test entitlement restriction
Search for the executive-services flagged member to observe the entitlement restriction message
actions.expect: An entitlement or access restriction message appears

actions.intent: Return to Member Servicing to re-lookup member 100244 and test the fault condition
Enter member 100244 again to trigger the sandbox fault state
Search for member 100244 again to observe the host fault error
actions.expect: A host error message appears instead of member details

declared_outcomes.name: member_not_found
declared_outcomes.marker_text: No member matching that number was found.
declared_outcomes.message: The searched member number does not exist in the system. The console displays 'No member matching that number was found.' along with the searched member number.

declared_outcomes.name: member_access_restricted
declared_outcomes.marker_text: You do not have permission to view this member.
declared_outcomes.message: Member 100999 is flagged EXECUTIVE SERVICES. A supervisor override is required to continue. The console shows an 'Access Restricted' panel with a 'Supervisor Override' button that a supervisor can use on this same session to clear the restriction and let the run continue.
declared_outcomes.remediation: A supervisor should click the 'Supervisor Override' button on this same session to clear the executive services flag and continue the lookup.

declared_recoveries.name: system_maintenance_notice
declared_recoveries.marker_text: Scheduled maintenance window 02:00–03:00 CT. Batch posting may be delayed. This notice is shown once per sign-on.
declared_recoveries.description: A one-time System Notice interstitial appears the first time Member Servicing is opened after sign-on, warning about a scheduled maintenance window. It is cleared by clicking the 'Acknowledge and Continue' button, after which the Member Servicing lookup screen appears normally. It does not reappear later in the same session.

declared_failures.name: host_transaction_error
declared_failures.message: The console displayed 'Application Error' with 'SYSTEM ERROR MC-5001' and the text 'The host transaction could not be completed. Contact the service desk with this reference.' This is a genuine application/host fault and the run must stop rather than treat it as a business answer.
